newsitem.title: USA: 360 Communications raises stake in 2 markets.
newsitem.headline: 360 Communications raises stake in 2 markets.

text.p: 360 Communications Co, which provides wireless phone services, said Thursday it increased its stake in two major markets in North Carolina and Ohio and divested its minority share in two rural areas in Iowa.
Terms of the agreements were not disclosed.

In North Carolina, the company said it acquired an additional seven percent interest in the partnership which serves the Raleigh-Durham, Burlington and Fayetteville areas. 360 said it now owns a 92 percent interest in those markets.
The company said it bought an additional 10 percent of the partnership serving the Toledo and Lima, Ohio, markets, increasing its ownership to 85 percent.
360 said it divested its 30 percent interest in the rural northeastern Iowa area north of Waterloo and its 14 percent interest in the rural market just west of Cedar Rapids.
The net effect of the four transactions is an increase of 150,000 potential customers, the company said.
